research_notes: The frozen occupation extract provides a continuous year-level sequence from 1995 to federal entry but not exact transitions or hours.
Union and political-staff employment are preserved separately and excluded from the narrow public/private headline under the approved codebook.
Customer-service, economist and senior political titles are not treated as proof of substantive full-time status.
Ministerial and electorate changes after 2013 are nested within federal elected service.

Systematic follow-up2026-10-01 resolved honours graduation year2000, corroborated AMWU National Projects Officer title at16May2005 and former-employee description by May2008, and added2013 candidacy without assuming paid/full-time campaign work.

Searched official parliamentary biography/first speech, ministerial and ASPI profiles, AMWU submissions, contemporary Senate inquiry, Rotary Warners Bay10August2020 newsletter, and Coles/Coles Myer historical corporate records. Rotary repeats customer-assistant work without individual hours. Coles Myer2002 SEC20-F provides corporate subsidiary/ownership and workforce context after his employment; it does not establish Conroy’s1995–2000 payroll entity or individual hours and is not used to infer them.

Queries for Coles full-time/part-time status and2013 campaign transition located no reliable individual hours or exact payroll boundaries. Preserve these gaps for targeted historical store/employer, alumni or public professional-profile leads; repeating generic biographies is unlikely to resolve them. Official first-speech link unavailable; OpenAustralia mirror recovered content. No job-wide tool error.

Second follow-up2October2026 materially resolves candidacy start27July2013 from contemporary AAP reporting of the party announcement. Former-staffer wording also supplies departure-by observation for Combet office, without inventing an exact cessation day. Campaign end uses known7September election, not assumed payroll duration.

Targeted Coles store/hours, AMWU transition and professional-profile searches yielded no new individual work terms. Customer-assistant recollections and existing2004–2008 economist interval recur. US author namesake and unrelated Coles security commentary excluded. Remaining work is personal appointment/leave and1995–2000 Coles payroll/hours evidence; union and political staff remain excluded.

Third follow-up4October2026 used exact-name searches for the1995–2000 Coles customer-service role and the AMWU National Projects Officer/National Economist titles. Official and primary results repeated the frozen occupation sequence and the16May2005 National Projects Officer observation; a Productivity Commission submission also showed the AMWU title and work email but supplied no appointment/promotion boundary, hours or leave. No personal Coles payroll/store evidence surfaced, and namesakes were excluded. No material change; retain the unresolved questions rather than infer full-time status or exact dates.

Follow-up2026-10-04: New primary party-history index identifies previously omitted2004–2007 National Conference proxy delegation; original member-authored2015 article dates Defence Materiel adviser duties2008–2010 within existing Combet-office service. No separate Defence employer, continuous whole-year term or hours inferred. May2010 CCH stafflist corroborates Materiel and Science portfolio without appointment boundaries. Coles payroll/store and personal AMWU leave/hours remain missing; generic reports and other people’s contracts not transferred.

2026-10-05 material follow-up: ANU2026 State of the Pacific program, printedp18/PDFpage19 visually checked, explicitly describes part-time work in Anthony Albanese’s electorate office while studying. ASPI2023 conference program printedp18 corroborates the same status. Changed only that employment_status from unknown to part_time, leaving FTE fraction and frozen2000 boundaries unresolved. Coles hours are not inferred from this separate job. AMWU National Projects Officer queries repeated16May2005 and previously checked submission observations; no new appointment, leave or promotion boundary found. Retain blocked totals and advance.

Second targeted pass2026-10-05: original CFMEU Forestry organiser and FWC personal-record routes found no appointment, pay, workload or leave evidence; results are existing hosted ministerial biographies or unrelated author, finance consultant and business-director namesakes. Conroys Smallgoods litigation concerns a distinct director and another employees later Coles job, not this member; no facts transferred. Hosted GDayUSA booklet corroborates already-supported part-time Albanese office work but its upload path is not the event/employment date. Retain named original union/personnel and Coles-store leads; indexed biography/industrial-case routes exhausted without material enrichment.

Third targeted pass2026-10-06: exact-title searches for AMWU National Projects Officer and National Economist, parliamentary-domain searches, exact Coles/University searches and the newly indexed Pat Conroy MP professional profile produced only the existing official1995–2000 Coles chronology,2000 honours graduation,16May2005 AMWU observation and unrelated namesakes. The APH route returned a non-retryable robots exclusion; public indexed official text was available but added no hours or boundaries. No personal store, payroll, appointment, promotion, leave or workload evidence was found, and no facts are inferred. Advance pending original Coles personnel/store or AMWU appointment records rather than repeating biography searches.
